comments.body:
Affected views:

If a LDPR/LDPC is a LDPRv, the UI does not indicate, or otherwise link to, to the related LDPCv.

If there is a LDPCv, its view does not list any associated LDPRms.

1. 4 Integration tests in FedoraLdpIT are breaking due to a 500 Error.  
  2. The cause of the 500 is
    javax.jcr.RepositoryException: The session with an ID of '060742fc6' has been closed and can no longer be used.

 

  1. It appears to be an OSX 10.13.x issue:  I've confirmed that it fails in both 10.13.4 and 10.13.6 issue :  Jared Whiklo and Peter Matthew Eichman have confirmed it as well.
    1. I confirmed It was not a problem for OSX 10.10.5

I figured out how to get this to build. I'm just adding quick bit to sort the Mementos by date and I'll open a PR.

I will clarify that the work currently shows the Memento's triples under "Other Resources" as the triples do not match the current subject.

This can be resolved in the templates, I just ran out of time.
